name: abilene_real_traffic
description:
SNVAng->NYCMng (Sunnyvale to New York) on Internet2's real Abilene network, driven by its real 5-minute traffic matrices (Zhang et al.) instead of synthetic dynamics: each step replays one real measured demand matrix, routed via OSPF(delay) onto the topology, with congestion/utilization/loss/queue derived from that real load (src/simulate/real_traffic.py). No scripted events.

Setup (not included in this repo -- data/raw/ is gitignored):
  1. Download the Abilene network file from https://sndlib.put.poznan.pl/abilene.overview.action and save it as data/raw/sndlib/networks/abilene.txt
  2. python scripts/fetch_sndlib_traffic.py --network abilene --limit 48
  3. python scripts/simulate.py --scenario configs/scenarios/abilene_real_traffic.json
'steps' below (48) matches the fetch script's default --limit; change both together if you use a different --limit.
